title: LLM-Based Human-Agent Collaboration and Interaction Systems: A Survey

layout.note: An isometric kitchen scene sits at the centre with three overlapping speech bubbles above and below it. Four rounded tinted boxes fill the corners (lilac top left, blue top right, orange bottom left, green bottom right) and tuck behind the scene; each holds two or three sub-dimensions as an icon row with a bold label and italic option names. The system title runs along the bottom.

lesson: Put one illustrated scenario at the centre as the hub, here a dialogue between human and agents in a concrete setting, and hang the taxonomy dimensions around it as pastel boxes, each an icon row with a bold sub-label and italic option names. Lettering the central component's name on the floor of the scene ties the story to the taxonomy.
